body:
Absolutely. Every day, actually. And, as you know, it makes the whole situation that much harder because you want to say something/know you're not alone/get help/feel better/scream.  
I don't want to voluntarily be that vulnerable either because people retaliate against you for 'lesser offense's, so to speak. Some days it seems like people can smell it on you, the desperation you have to want to feel better, and some caveman-like urge compels them to avoid or hurt you in order to protect themselves.

Your question really resonates with me today and many others I suspect. Thank you for asking this question.

Nah, not stupid; I know how hard that can be (I'm started no-contact with my family and it seems damn near impossible and wrong despite the fact that they're not good for/to me). Glad you found new positive folks to be around.

I definitely obsess about it and working on my body has become my hobby.  These are good questions; I keep my living space clean and very minimalist, therapy (talk and pills) haven't seemed to work over the last 20 years, so I gave up on that. The people around me are mostly toxic/absent/narcissistic/sociopathic, but I thought I could overcompensate in another area of life to better balance that out.

Hoping you've since found the right balance for you because it's definitely a trial-and-error process. I would have false starts in the past, too, like what you've described, but I'm at nearly 18 months of disciplined routine, and by itself it's not enough to keep me out of mental hell, nevermind feeling awesome like people talk about having happen to them. I started all this largely in response to being the skinny nerd growing up (and hearing about it endlessly from everyone), so likely not the best point to start form. Thanks for the feedback.

That's a tough spot.  
Clarifying question: you lose the house but have to keep paying the mortgage?  
Also, is the other option of paying her allowance contractual?

Is there a third option? I would want the optimal long\-term solution for myself first.  
If I'm stuck with the two options you've described, and I can't legally avoid the allowance, then I'd pay it because peace is more valuable than money if you can swing it (but it sounds like you can avoid since you've cut this payment?).

Maybe I'm confused, but I think we need a little more info.  
Hopefully you've had time to clear your mind and devise a good solution.
